_note: California ZIP code (2020 Census ZCTA) -> likely districts for the 3 Nov 2026 election. Congressional: AB 604 (Ch. 96, Stats. 2025) districts adopted by Proposition 50 (approved Nov 4, 2025; certified Dec 12, 2025), block equivalency file https://statewidedatabase.org/pub/data/d25/AB604.zip (cross-checked identical to https://selc.senate.ca.gov/media/604). State Senate: 2021 Citizens Redistricting Commission final map, block equivalency https://wedrawthelines.ca.gov/wp-content/uploads/sites/64/2023/01/OneDrive_2023-01-19-4.zip. Assembly: 2021 Citizens Redistricting Commission final map, block equivalency https://wedrawthelines.ca.gov/wp-content/uploads/sites/64/2023/01/OneDrive_2023-01-19-6.zip. All three district assignments were checked block-for-block to be identical to the Census Bureau block equivalency files for the 120th Congress and the 2026 state legislative districts: https://www2.census.gov/programs-surveys/decennial/rdo/mapping-files/2027/120-congressional-district-befs/cd120.zip, https://www2.census.gov/programs-surveys/decennial/rdo/mapping-files/2027/2026-state-legislative-bef/sldu26.zip, https://www2.census.gov/programs-surveys/decennial/rdo/mapping-files/2027/2026-state-legislative-bef/sldl26.zip. Blocks -> ZCTA: https://www2.census.gov/geo/docs/maps-data/data/rel2020/zcta520/tab20_zcta520_tabblock20_natl.txt. Block population: 2020 Census P.L. 94-171 P1_001N (total population) from https://www2.census.gov/programs-surveys/decennial/2020/data/01-Redistricting_File--PL_94-171/California/ca2020.pl.zip. City: Census 2020 place (incorporated place or CDP) from https://www2.census.gov/geo/docs/maps-data/data/baf2020/BlockAssign_ST06_CA.zip with names from https://www2.census.gov/geo/docs/reference/codes2020/place/st06_ca_place2020.txt; county names from https://www2.census.gov/geo/docs/reference/codes2020/cou/st06_ca_cou2020.txt. Method: each ZCTA gets, per district type, the district holding the largest share of its 2020 population (land area for unpopulated ZCTAs); 'shares' gives that share and 'split' is true when any share is below 95%. 'city' is the Census place holding the most population (empty if most people live outside any place); it can differ from the USPS city name. ZIP codes are not district boundaries: split ZIPs need a full address. Built by scripts/build_zip_districts.py.
